title: Why vibration draws patterns in sand
description:
A vibrating plate leaves a map of stillness. Moving regions bounce the grains away; sand gathers near stationary nodal lines. Different vibration modes can produce different patterns, and the plate and its supports matter.

Original illustrative animation with synthetic narration. Motion and grain paths are qualitative; tones are not calibrated to the displayed patterns.
Sources: Smithsonian, Exploratorium and UNSW Physics.
#Chladni #Physics #Sound
firstComment: A different vibration mode can change the pattern, but the plate and how it is held also matter. This is an illustrative model, not recorded laboratory footage.
